recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. If the work group wants additional modern Consent examples, binding refinements, or cleanup of dormant ConsentDirective/PCD source files, that should be handled under a new current build-scope issue rather than this historical documentation audit.
issue_request: FHIR-7532 was a Published/Persuasive 2015May FHIR-core profiles issue from CBCC saying the old Consent/ConsentDirective documentation had no example, no introduction, and no bindings, making it hard to understand how to use. The final resolution says no action was required because the specification now has many examples and bindings.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly citing FHIR-7532 was found. The relevant application appears to have happened through the broader ConsentDirective-to-Consent migration: acc3f3137b introduced Consent as a resource with Consent-specific examples, narrative, code systems, value sets, and fhir.ini resource registration; ba3db96597 and 1264e32b13 expanded and simplified the Consent documentation and examples; 94445ca431 recorded that ConsentDirective became Consent.
additional_context: Consent is active in the current build configuration, while the old PCD implementation guide entry is commented and the remaining source/contract/consentdirective.profile.xml file has no active fhir.ini profiles entry. Closely related ConsentDirective issues FHIR-7253 and FHIR-7533 are already represented on the combined branch with no-change audits explaining the resource replacement, and FHIR-11064 is already represented as a later Consent narrative wording audit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope Consent source includes Scope and Usage introduction text, Privacy Consent Directive model/background text, a registered list of Consent examples, and StructureDefinition bindings for status, category, regulatory basis, decision, provision action/security-label/purpose/document/resource/code/data meaning, and related elements.
